name: Gem Dragonborn
reviewNotes: This native record establishes only the approved nonselectable Gem family inheritance node; it is not a playable Dragonborn selection.
Amethyst, Crystal, Emerald, Sapphire and Topaz leaves are reserved for later reconciliation and have not been created in native.

Gem-specific breath weapon geometry, elemental or other damage affinity, resistance mapping, special traits and inherited adaptations remain unresolved. No mechanics should be inferred from the empty traits array.
No Upbringing is selected or assigned by default. The currently selectable Dragonborn leaves remain the five Chromatic and five Metallic types.
